dataset_meta.name: ORATS Earnings / Options Implied & Historical Volatility
dataset_meta.probe_method: WorldQuant BRAIN /data-fields REST via D:/brain-mcp get_datafields (USA/TOP3000/D1, filter_sharpe=False, 全量 375 字段, 2026-11-11)

portrait_methodology.rule: event-indexed historical announcement snapshots => quarterly step function (is_stepwise=true, 严禁裸用 [-1] 快照); rolling option/IV/vol/OI/price panels => daily; signed percent moves & effects => unbounded; positive-only magnitudes => [0, inf); coverage≈0.969 with dateCoverage≈0.951 => is_sparse=false across the board; heavy-tailed move/vol/price => skewness=high
portrait_methodology.zero_hallucination: 所有 375 个字段名 100% 来自 BRAIN API 原始返回，未臆造任何字段
